usedFor: Qwilr builds proposals and sales pages, with “Create Page” starting one from a template or saved blocks.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Update Page” in Qwilr
bestTemplate.why: The action can publish, retag, move or change the expiry of a page, so the page follows the meeting.

watchOut: “Update Page” can publish a page, so check which page it targets before it runs.
